codeReview.summary: The feature correctly addresses VAL-CRIT-002. It adds a dedicated destroy() cleanup path that disconnects the sidepanel ResizeObserver and clears the stored reference, and wires that cleanup into both pagehide and beforeunload so the observer is released when the sidepanel is closed or navigated away from. I did not find correctness or regression issues in the reviewed change.
